iterations.text: Here is how it goes. ```chi-ui type: walk title: A tab reconnects actors: [user, web, worker] steps: - id: s1 actor: user does: reopens the laptop sees: '' - id: s2 actor: worker does: checks the event id cases: - when: the id is still buffered goto: s3 - when: the id is too old goto: s4 - id: s3 actor: worker does: replays the missed events next: s5 - id: s4 actor: web does: reloads the session behind: the stream sends reset - id: s5 actor: user sees: the page as it was ``` And what to do with the findings: ```chi-ui type: picks title: Findings rows: - id: "1" text: Bridge drops the replay buffer on reset options: [fix now, skip, later] recommended: fix now - id: D4 text: Cache key options: [A, B] recommended: A ```
